mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(unpaid_amount), 0) FROM ap_invoice WHERE supplier_id = #{supplierId} AND deleted = 0

SELECT CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), due_date) <= 30 THEN '0-30天' WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), due_date) <= 60 THEN '31-60天' WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), due_date) <= 90 THEN '61-90天' ELSE '90天以上' END AS bucket, COALESCE(SUM(unpaid_amount), 0) AS amount, COUNT(*) AS count FROM ap_invoice WHERE supplier_id = #{supplierId} AND deleted = 0 AND unpaid_amount > 0 GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket
